text_block_list.text:
I came for the year's first shrine visit 
with Gold Ship, but…

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Damnation……!! Why must it…!! Damn it, damn 
it……!!

― Since arriving at the shrine, Gold Ship 
has been angry about something!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
What happened in a measly year……!? Why did 
things turn out like this!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Can't you tell!!? I'm talking about 
yakisoba!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh, mercy! This time every year, countless 
stalls are lined up…! And among all them, 
there was a yakisoba stall!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
And yet…… this year, I can't find it 
anywhere!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Why for? Are you telling me the yakisoba 
did something wrong?! Did they…?!

… I have no clue what's up with the stall. 
Though I think they sometimes just don't 
have one.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Damn…… damn it……!! Treating yakisoba so 
carelessly!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
If that's how it is, I have some ideas 
too…!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I've made up my mind! This year, I'll give 
my all to become the horsegirl leading the 
yakisoba world to new heights!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I will re-introduce the public to the 
wonders of yakisoba, educate and enlighten 
them—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna push yakisoba back to the 
world's number one junk food spot!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
You're gonna help me, of course!? With 
that said, where do you think we should 
start?

I don't know what answer she's expecting 
but for the moment…
choice_data_list:
Have some to put the taste fresh in our 
minds.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: The taste, in our minds?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
That's true, I need to be the one who best 
understands yakisoba…

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
If not, I won't be able to convince others 
of its wonders…

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
So, I will understand you, yakisoba!! I'll 
give you my love… deeper, and more 
intensely than anyone!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Preparing… it…?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I see, what's lacking is charismatic 
techniques…!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
If I could cook up yakisoba out of thin 
air with my divine technique… That would 
be hit news for sure…!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
A'ight! I'm gonna take the yakisoba world 
by storm with my illusionist skills!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Did you just say… novel combinations!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
You're absolutely right.…… Stereotypical 
yakisoba ain't gonna change the world…!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Fortunately, we have freedom of 
expression. To use sweets, to get rid of 
the noodles entirely… I can do whatever I 
want!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Let's do it, dive into the endless ocean! 
I'll bring the colours of the rainbow to 
yakisoba!!
